tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Every screen background on the TV and the phone (REQ-FL-45). Text on it: text, text-dim, accent.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text and the outer line of a frame. 20.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: button-edge
tokens.usage: The lower edge of the round A (green) and B (red) buttons, under the face (issue #173). 8.4:1 on the black face. Every enabled button has the face `bg`, white text and a white border (`text`, 20.5:1).

tokens.name: text-info
tokens.usage: Info text that is active: the player range, WAIT, empty slots (issue #221). White like text since 2026-11-02 (owner). 20.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-desc
tokens.usage: Hints and descriptions: the description of the focused game, the help lines, how to play (owner, 2026-11-03). A little under white, so the yellow reason under a description stands out. 13.5:1 on bg, between text-info and text-dim.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: A disabled item only, and the line of things that are off. Never the text of an enabled item. 5.0:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Titles, the room code, the focused item, PRESS OK. 11.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The inner line of a double frame. Not for text (3.8:1).

tokens.name: slot-empty
tokens.usage: The square of an empty slot and of the players badge. Not for text.

tokens.name: dim-layer
tokens.usage: Dim layer under a modal or a game menu.

tokens.name: player-1
tokens.usage: Player slot 1 (cyan). Always shown with the slot number.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: SABABI text logo when the logo file is missing.

styles.name: modal-title
styles.usage: Modal and menu titles, accent yellow.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default label, help text, tile titles, player range. The TV minimum.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a game board box.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a game board box.

tokens.name: line-w
tokens.usage: One line of a frame at 1080p. A double frame is line, gap and line.

tokens.name: chip-line-w
tokens.usage: The frame of a game chip, the timer and the hint plate.
